audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds' and never gives Cyclone's cooldown.
audit.why: Cyclone is 130s at rank 1 down to 90s and only reaches 315 units — it is a long-cooldown, short-range spin, so baiting it out buys you two full minutes rather than a single dodge. Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names both ultimates and gives the 130s and the 315 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Warrior Trickster is described only as a 'clone juke'. The invisibility is never stated, and Crushing Blow's auto-reset is not flagged.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster (W, 22s at rank 1 down to 18s) makes Wukong INVISIBLE while he dashes and leaves the clone behind — so the clone is not the trick, the disappearance is. You are not choosing between two visible bodies; you are losing sight of the real one. Crushing Blow (Q, 8s down to 6s) is an auto-attack RESET that also shreds armour, so his burst opens with an attack wind-up rather than a spell cast — the wind-up is your cue to step back. Nimbus Strike is 10s at rank 1 down to 7s.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt on Warrior Trickster's invisibility and Crushing Blow's reset with the real numbers.
